Exo.13.20.bsb: They set out from Succoth and camped at Etham on the edge of the wilderness.
Exo.13.20.kjv: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.

Exo.13.21.bsb: And the LORD went before them in a pillar of cloud to guide their way by day, and in a pillar of fire to give them light by night, so that they could travel by day or night.
Exo.13.21.kjv: And the Lord went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:

Exo.34.5.bsb: And the LORD descended in a cloud, stood with him there, and proclaimed His name, the LORD.
Exo.34.5.kjv: And the Lord descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the Lord.

Exo.13.22.bsb: Neither the pillar of cloud by day nor the pillar of fire by night left its place before the people.
Exo.13.22.kjv: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, from before the people.

Exo.33.9.bsb: As Moses entered the tent, the pillar of cloud would come down and remain at the entrance, and the LORD would speak with Moses.
Exo.33.9.kjv: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and the Lord talked with Moses.

Exo.33.10.bsb: When all the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance to the tent, they would stand up and worship, each one at the entrance to his own tent.
Exo.33.10.kjv: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man in his tent door.

Exo.33.14.bsb: And the LORD answered, “My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
Exo.33.14.kjv: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.

Exo.33.15.bsb: “If Your Presence does not go with us,” Moses replied, “do not lead us up from here.
Exo.33.15.kjv: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not with me, carry us not up hence.

Exo.16.10.bsb: And as Aaron was speaking to the whole congregation of Israel, they looked toward the desert, and there in a cloud the glory of the LORD appeared.
Exo.16.10.kjv: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of the Lord appeared in the cloud.

Exo.40.35.bsb: Moses was unable to enter the Tent of Meeting because the cloud had settled on it, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
Exo.40.35.kjv: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.

Exo.24.16.bsb: and the glory of the LORD settled on Mount Sinai. For six days the cloud covered it, and on the seventh day the LORD called to Moses from within the cloud.
Exo.24.16.kjv: And the glory of the Lord abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.

Exo.40.36.bsb: Whenever the cloud was lifted from above the tabernacle, the Israelites would set out through all the stages of their journey.
Exo.40.36.kjv: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:

Exo.40.37.bsb: If the cloud was not lifted, they would not set out until the day it was taken up.
Exo.40.37.kjv: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.

Exo.14.19.bsb: And the angel of God, who had gone before the camp of Israel, withdrew and went behind them. The pillar of cloud also moved from before them and stood behind them,
Exo.14.19.kjv: And the angel of God, which went before the camp of Israel, removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:

Exo.40.34.bsb: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
Exo.40.34.kjv: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.

Exo.14.20.bsb: so that it came between the camps of Egypt and Israel. The cloud was there in the darkness, but it lit up the night. So all night long neither camp went near the other.
Exo.14.20.kjv: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel; and it was a cloud and darkness to them, but it gave light by night to these: so that the one came not near the other all the night.

Exo.40.38.bsb: For the cloud of the LORD was over the tabernacle by day, and fire was in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel through all their journeys.
Exo.40.38.kjv: For the cloud of the Lord was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

Exo.19.9.bsb: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I will come to you in a dense cloud, so that the people will hear when I speak with you, and they will always put their trust in you.” And Moses relayed to the LORD what the people had said.
Exo.19.9.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto the Lord.

Exo.19.16.bsb: On the third day, when morning came, there was thunder and lightning. A thick cloud was upon the mountain, and a very loud blast of the ram’s horn went out, so that all the people in the camp trembled.
Exo.19.16.kjv: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled.

Exo.24.17.bsb: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like a consuming fire on the mountaintop in the eyes of the Israelites.
Exo.24.17.kjv: And the sight of the glory of the Lord was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.

Exo.24.18.bsb: Moses entered the cloud as he went up on the mountain, and he remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
Exo.24.18.kjv: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.

Exo.20.11.bsb: For in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth and the sea and all that is in them, but on the seventh day He rested. Therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day and set it apart as holy.
Exo.20.11.kjv: For in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the Lord blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.

Exo.31.17.bsb: It is a sign between Me and the Israelites forever; for in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth, but on the seventh day He rested and was refreshed.’”
Exo.31.17.kjv: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.

Exo.15.1.bsb: Then Moses and the Israelites sang this song to the LORD: “I will sing to the LORD, for He is highly exalted. The horse and rider He has thrown into the sea.
Exo.15.1.kjv: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the Lord, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the Lord, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.

Exo.15.6.bsb: Your right hand, O LORD, is majestic in power; Your right hand, O LORD, has shattered the enemy.
Exo.15.6.kjv: Thy right hand, O Lord, is become glorious in power: thy right hand, O Lord, hath dashed in pieces the enemy.

Exo.15.11.bsb: Who among the gods is like You, O LORD? Who is like You—majestic in holiness, revered with praises, performing wonders?
Exo.15.11.kjv: Who is like unto thee, O Lord, among the gods? who is like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?

Exo.34.6.bsb: Then the LORD passed in front of Moses and called out: “The LORD, the LORD God, is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness,
Exo.34.6.kjv: And the Lord passed by before him, and proclaimed, The Lord, The Lord God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,

Exo.34.7.bsb: maintaining loving devotion to a thousand generations, forgiving iniquity, transgression, and sin. Yet He will by no means leave the guilty unpunished; He will visit the iniquity of the fathers on their children and grandchildren to the third and fourth generations.”
Exo.34.7.kjv: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children’s children, unto the third and to the fourth generation.

Exo.33.18.bsb: Then Moses said, “Please show me Your glory.”
Exo.33.18.kjv: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.

Exo.33.19.bsb: “I will cause all My goodness to pass before you,” the LORD replied, “and I will proclaim My name—the LORD—in your presence. I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
Exo.33.19.kjv: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the Lord before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.

Exo.33.20.bsb: But He added, “You cannot see My face, for no one can see Me and live.”
Exo.33.20.kjv: And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.

Exo.33.21.bsb: The LORD continued, “There is a place near Me where you are to stand upon a rock,
Exo.33.21.kjv: And the Lord said, Behold, there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon a rock:

Exo.33.22.bsb: and when My glory passes by, I will put you in a cleft of the rock and cover you with My hand until I have passed by.
Exo.33.22.kjv: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a clift of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:

Exo.33.23.bsb: Then I will take My hand away, and you will see My back; but My face must not be seen.”
Exo.33.23.kjv: And I will take away mine hand, and thou shalt see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.

Exo.4.31.bsb: and they believed. And when they heard that the LORD had attended to the Israelites and had seen their affliction, they bowed down and worshiped.
Exo.4.31.kjv: And the people believed: and when they heard that the Lord had visited the children of Israel, and that he had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.

Exo.4.6.bsb: Furthermore, the LORD said to Moses, “Put your hand inside your cloak.” So he put his hand inside his cloak, and when he took it out, his hand was leprous, white as snow.
Exo.4.6.kjv: And the Lord said furthermore unto him, Put now thine hand into thy bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom: and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous as snow.

Exo.32.32.bsb: Yet now, if You would only forgive their sin.... But if not, please blot me out of the book that You have written.”
Exo.32.32.kjv: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin—; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.

Exo.23.4.bsb: If you encounter your enemy’s stray ox or donkey, you must return it to him.
Exo.23.4.kjv: If thou meet thine enemy’s ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.

Exo.23.5.bsb: If you see the donkey of one who hates you fallen under its load, do not leave it there; you must help him with it.
Exo.23.5.kjv: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.

Exo.12.3.bsb: Tell the whole congregation of Israel that on the tenth day of this month each man must select a lamb for his family, one per household.
Exo.12.3.kjv: Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel, saying, In the tenth day of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to the house of their fathers, a lamb for an house:

Exo.12.5.bsb: Your lamb must be an unblemished year-old male, and you may take it from the sheep or the goats.
Exo.12.5.kjv: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year: ye shall take it out from the sheep, or from the goats:

Exo.12.6.bsb: You must keep it until the fourteenth day of the month, when the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel will slaughter the animals at twilight.
Exo.12.6.kjv: And ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month: and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening.

Exo.12.7.bsb: They are to take some of the blood and put it on the sides and tops of the doorframes of the houses where they eat the lambs.
Exo.12.7.kjv: And they shall take of the blood, and strike it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses, wherein they shall eat it.

Exo.12.22.bsb: Take a cluster of hyssop, dip it into the blood in the basin, and brush the blood on the top and sides of the doorframe. None of you shall go out the door of his house until morning.
Exo.12.22.kjv: And ye shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the bason, and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood that is in the bason; and none of you shall go out at the door of his house until the morning.

Exo.12.46.bsb: It must be eaten inside one house. You are not to take any of the meat outside the house, and you may not break any of the bones.
Exo.12.46.kjv: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.

Exo.12.9.bsb: Do not eat any of the meat raw or cooked in boiling water, but only roasted over the fire—its head and legs and inner parts.
Exo.12.9.kjv: Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast with fire; his head with his legs, and with the purtenance thereof.

Exo.12.8.bsb: They are to eat the meat that night, roasted over the fire, along with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
Exo.12.8.kjv: And they shall eat the flesh in that night, roast with fire, and unleavened bread; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it.

Exo.12.39.bsb: Since their dough had no leaven, the people baked what they had brought out of Egypt into unleavened loaves. For when they had been driven out of Egypt, they could not delay and had not prepared any provisions for themselves.
Exo.12.39.kjv: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought forth out of Egypt, for it was not leavened; because they were thrust out of Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they prepared for themselves any victual.

Exo.12.11.bsb: This is how you are to eat it: You must be fully dressed for travel, with your sandals on your feet and your staff in your hand. You are to eat in haste; it is the LORD’s Passover.
Exo.12.11.kjv: And thus shall ye eat it; with your loins girded, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and ye shall eat it in haste: it is the Lord’s passover.

Exo.12.10.bsb: Do not leave any of it until morning; before the morning you must burn up any part that is left over.
Exo.12.10.kjv: And ye shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; and that which remaineth of it until the morning ye shall burn with fire.

Exo.32.11.bsb: But Moses sought the favor of the LORD his God, saying, “O LORD, why does Your anger burn against Your people, whom You brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and a mighty hand?
Exo.32.11.kjv: And Moses besought the Lord his God, and said, Lord, why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people, which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?

Exo.32.13.bsb: Remember Your servants Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, to whom You swore by Your very self when You declared, ‘I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky, and I will give your descendants all this land that I have promised, and it shall be their inheritance forever.’”
Exo.32.13.kjv: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.

Exo.2.23.bsb: After a long time, the king of Egypt died. The Israelites groaned and cried out under their burden of slavery, and their cry for deliverance from bondage ascended to God.
Exo.2.23.kjv: And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage.

Exo.2.24.bsb: So God heard their groaning, and He remembered His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
Exo.2.24.kjv: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.

Exo.17.4.bsb: Then Moses cried out to the LORD, “What should I do with these people? A little more and they will stone me!”
Exo.17.4.kjv: And Moses cried unto the Lord, saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.

Exo.17.5.bsb: And the LORD said to Moses, “Walk on ahead of the people and take some of the elders of Israel with you. Take along in your hand the staff with which you struck the Nile, and go.
Exo.17.5.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Israel; and thy rod, wherewith thou smotest the river, take in thine hand, and go.

Exo.17.6.bsb: Behold, I will stand there before you by the rock at Horeb. And when you strike the rock, water will come out of it for the people to drink.” So Moses did this in the sight of the elders of Israel.
Exo.17.6.kjv: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.

Exo.17.11.bsb: As long as Moses held up his hands, Israel prevailed; but when he lowered them, Amalek prevailed.
Exo.17.11.kjv: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

Exo.17.12.bsb: When Moses’ hands grew heavy, they took a stone and put it under him, and he sat on it. Then Aaron and Hur held his hands up, one on each side, so that his hands remained steady until the sun went down.
Exo.17.12.kjv: But Moses’ hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.

Exo.17.13.bsb: So Joshua overwhelmed Amalek and his army with the sword.
Exo.17.13.kjv: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

Exo.32.12.bsb: Why should the Egyptians declare, ‘He brought them out with evil intent, to kill them in the mountains and wipe them from the face of the earth’? Turn from Your fierce anger and relent from doing harm to Your people.
Exo.32.12.kjv: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.

Exo.32.14.bsb: So the LORD relented from the calamity He had threatened to bring on His people.
Exo.32.14.kjv: And the Lord repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.

Exo.8.12.bsb: After Moses and Aaron had left Pharaoh, Moses cried out to the LORD for help with the frogs that He had brought against Pharaoh.
Exo.8.12.kjv: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh: and Moses cried unto the Lord because of the frogs which he had brought against Pharaoh.

Exo.20.24.bsb: You are to make for Me an altar of earth, and sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and peace offerings, your sheep and goats and cattle. In every place where I cause My name to be remembered, I will come to you and bless you.
Exo.20.24.kjv: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me, and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings, and thy peace offerings, thy sheep, and thine oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee, and I will bless thee.

Exo.15.20.bsb: Then Miriam the prophetess, Aaron’s sister, took a tambourine in her hand, and all the women followed her with tambourines and dancing.
Exo.15.20.kjv: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.

Exo.15.21.bsb: And Miriam sang back to them: “Sing to the LORD, for He is highly exalted; the horse and rider He has thrown into the sea.”
Exo.15.21.kjv: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the Lord, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.

Exo.4.1.bsb: Then Moses answered, “What if they do not believe me or listen to my voice? For they may say, ‘The LORD has not appeared to you.’”
Exo.4.1.kjv: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say, The Lord hath not appeared unto thee.

Exo.4.2.bsb: And the LORD asked him, “What is that in your hand?” “A staff,” he replied.
Exo.4.2.kjv: And the Lord said unto him, What is that in thine hand? And he said, A rod.

Exo.4.3.bsb: “Throw it on the ground,” said the LORD. So Moses threw it on the ground, and it became a snake, and he ran from it.
Exo.4.3.kjv: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.

Exo.4.4.bsb: “Stretch out your hand and grab it by the tail,” the LORD said to Moses, who reached out his hand and caught the snake, and it turned back into a staff in his hand.
Exo.4.4.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Put forth thine hand, and take it by the tail. And he put forth his hand, and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand:

Exo.7.1.bsb: The LORD answered Moses, “See, I have made you like God to Pharaoh, and your brother Aaron will be your prophet.
Exo.7.1.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.

Exo.14.22.bsb: and the Israelites went through the sea on dry ground, with walls of water on their right and on their left.
Exo.14.22.kjv: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.

Exo.19.10.bsb: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go to the people and consecrate them today and tomorrow. They must wash their clothes
Exo.19.10.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,

Exo.29.4.bsb: Then present Aaron and his sons at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.
Exo.29.4.kjv: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shalt wash them with water.

Exo.24.5.bsb: Then he sent out some young men of Israel, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as peace offerings to the LORD.
Exo.24.5.kjv: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the Lord.

Exo.24.6.bsb: Moses took half of the blood and put it in bowls, and the other half he splattered on the altar.
Exo.24.6.kjv: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

Exo.24.7.bsb: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it to the people, who replied, “All that the LORD has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient.”
Exo.24.7.kjv: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the Lord hath said will we do, and be obedient.

Exo.24.8.bsb: So Moses took the blood, splattered it on the people, and said, “This is the blood of the covenant that the LORD has made with you in accordance with all these words.”
Exo.24.8.kjv: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the Lord hath made with you concerning all these words.

Exo.30.19.bsb: with which Aaron and his sons are to wash their hands and feet.
Exo.30.19.kjv: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:

Exo.30.18.bsb: “You are to make a bronze basin with a bronze stand for washing. Set it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water in it,
Exo.30.18.kjv: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass, and his foot also of brass, to wash withal: and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.

Exo.34.33.bsb: When Moses had finished speaking with them, he put a veil over his face.
Exo.34.33.kjv: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.

Exo.2.8.bsb: “Go ahead,” Pharaoh’s daughter told her. And the girl went and called the boy’s mother.
Exo.2.8.kjv: And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child’s mother.

Exo.22.17.bsb: If her father absolutely refuses to give her to him, the man still must pay an amount comparable to the bridal price of a virgin.
Exo.22.17.kjv: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

Exo.22.16.bsb: If a man seduces a virgin who is not pledged in marriage and sleeps with her, he must pay the full dowry for her to be his wife.
Exo.22.16.kjv: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.

Exo.38.8.bsb: Next he made the bronze basin and its stand from the mirrors of the women who served at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
Exo.38.8.kjv: And he made the laver of brass, and the foot of it of brass, of the lookingglasses of the women assembling, which assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

Exo.2.16.bsb: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters, and they came to draw water and fill the troughs to water their father’s flock.
Exo.2.16.kjv: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.

Exo.21.22.bsb: If men who are fighting strike a pregnant woman and her child is born prematurely, but there is no further injury, he shall surely be fined as the woman’s husband demands and as the court allows.
Exo.21.22.kjv: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman’s husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.

Exo.21.23.bsb: But if a serious injury results, then you must require a life for a life—
Exo.21.23.kjv: And if any mischief follow, then thou shalt give life for life,

Exo.21.24.bsb: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
Exo.21.24.kjv: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

Exo.21.25.bsb: burn for burn, wound for wound, and stripe for stripe.
Exo.21.25.kjv: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.

Exo.2.5.bsb: Soon the daughter of Pharaoh went down to bathe in the Nile, and her attendants were walking along the riverbank. And when she saw the basket among the reeds, she sent her maidservant to retrieve it.
Exo.2.5.kjv: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river’s side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.

Exo.2.6.bsb: When she opened it, she saw the child, and behold, the little boy was crying. So she had compassion on him and said, “This is one of the Hebrew children.”
Exo.2.6.kjv: And when she had opened it, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews’ children.

Exo.2.7.bsb: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Shall I go and call one of the Hebrew women to nurse the child for you?”
Exo.2.7.kjv: Then said his sister to Pharaoh’s daughter, Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for thee?

Exo.2.9.bsb: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child and nurse him for me, and I will pay your wages.” So the woman took the boy and nursed him.
Exo.2.9.kjv: And Pharaoh’s daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give thee thy wages. And the woman took the child, and nursed it.

Exo.2.10.bsb: When the child had grown older, she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses and explained, “I drew him out of the water.”
Exo.2.10.kjv: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.

Exo.4.22.bsb: Then tell Pharaoh that this is what the LORD says: ‘Israel is My firstborn son,
Exo.4.22.kjv: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith the Lord, Israel is my son, even my firstborn:

Exo.4.23.bsb: and I told you to let My son go so that he may worship Me. But since you have refused to let him go, behold, I will kill your firstborn son!’”
Exo.4.23.kjv: And I say unto thee, Let my son go, that he may serve me: and if thou refuse to let him go, behold, I will slay thy son, even thy firstborn.

Exo.3.2.bsb: There the angel of the LORD appeared to him in a blazing fire from within a bush. Moses saw the bush ablaze with fire, but it was not consumed.
Exo.3.2.kjv: And the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.

Exo.23.20.bsb: Behold, I am sending an angel before you to protect you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.
Exo.23.20.kjv: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.

Exo.23.23.bsb: For My angel will go before you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will annihilate them.
Exo.23.23.kjv: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.

Exo.32.34.bsb: Now go, lead the people to the place I described. Behold, My angel shall go before you. But on the day I settle accounts, I will punish them for their sin.”
Exo.32.34.kjv: Therefore now go, lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee: behold, mine Angel shall go before thee: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.

Exo.33.2.bsb: And I will send an angel before you, and I will drive out the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
Exo.33.2.kjv: And I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:

Exo.10.11.bsb: No, only the men may go and worship the LORD, since that is what you have been requesting.” And Moses and Aaron were driven from Pharaoh’s presence.
Exo.10.11.kjv: Not so: go now ye that are men, and serve the Lord; for that ye did desire. And they were driven out from Pharaoh’s presence.

Exo.10.28.bsb: “Depart from me!” Pharaoh said to Moses. “Make sure you never see my face again, for on the day you see my face, you will die.”
Exo.10.28.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto him, Get thee from me, take heed to thyself, see my face no more; for in that day thou seest my face thou shalt die.

Exo.11.8.bsb: And all these officials of yours will come and bow before me, saying, ‘Go, you and all the people who follow you!’ After that, I will depart.” And hot with anger, Moses left Pharaoh’s presence.
Exo.11.8.kjv: And all these thy servants shall come down unto me, and bow down themselves unto me, saying, Get thee out, and all the people that follow thee: and after that I will go out. And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger.

Exo.22.24.bsb: My anger will be kindled, and I will kill you with the sword; then your wives will become widows and your children will be fatherless.
Exo.22.24.kjv: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

Exo.32.10.bsb: Now leave Me alone, so that My anger may burn against them and consume them. Then I will make you into a great nation.”
Exo.32.10.kjv: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.

Exo.33.5.bsb: For the LORD had said to Moses, “Tell the Israelites, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I should go with you for a single moment, I would destroy you. Now take off your jewelry, and I will decide what to do with you.’”
Exo.33.5.kjv: For the Lord had said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye are a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do unto thee.

Exo.3.8.bsb: I have come down to rescue them from the hand of the Egyptians and to bring them up out of that land to a good and spacious land, a land flowing with milk and honey—the home of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
Exo.3.8.kjv: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

Exo.14.24.bsb: At morning watch, however, the LORD looked down on the army of the Egyptians from the pillar of fire and cloud, and He threw their camp into confusion.
Exo.14.24.kjv: And it came to pass, that in the morning watch the Lord looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the host of the Egyptians,

Exo.20.5.bsb: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on their children to the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me,
Exo.20.5.kjv: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;

Exo.17.7.bsb: He named the place Massah and Meribah because the Israelites quarreled, and because they tested the LORD, saying, “Is the LORD among us or not?”
Exo.17.7.kjv: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the Lord, saying, Is the Lord among us, or not?

Exo.17.1.bsb: Then the whole congregation of Israel left the Desert of Sin, moving from place to place as the LORD commanded. They camped at Rephidim, but there was no water for the people to drink.
Exo.17.1.kjv: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of the Lord, and pitched in Rephidim: and there was no water for the people to drink.

Exo.17.2.bsb: So the people contended with Moses, “Give us water to drink.” “Why do you contend with me?” Moses replied. “Why do you test the LORD?”
Exo.17.2.kjv: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said unto them, Why chide ye with me? wherefore do ye tempt the Lord?

Exo.17.3.bsb: But the people thirsted for water there, and they grumbled against Moses: “Why have you brought us out of Egypt—to make us and our children and livestock die of thirst?”
Exo.17.3.kjv: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?

Exo.20.7.bsb: You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain, for the LORD will not leave anyone unpunished who takes His name in vain.
Exo.20.7.kjv: Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain; for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

Exo.5.2.bsb: But Pharaoh replied, “Who is the LORD that I should obey His voice and let Israel go? I do not know the LORD, and I will not let Israel go.”
Exo.5.2.kjv: And Pharaoh said, Who is the Lord, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go? I know not the Lord, neither will I let Israel go.

Exo.28.40.bsb: Make tunics, sashes, and headbands for Aaron’s sons, to give them glory and splendor.
Exo.28.40.kjv: And for Aaron’s sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and bonnets shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty.

Exo.29.9.bsb: Wrap the sashes around Aaron and his sons and tie headbands on them. The priesthood shall be theirs by a permanent statute. In this way you are to ordain Aaron and his sons.
Exo.29.9.kjv: And thou shalt gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and put the bonnets on them: and the priest’s office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.

Exo.39.28.bsb: as well as the turban of fine linen, the ornate headbands and undergarments of finely spun linen,
Exo.39.28.kjv: And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,

Exo.29.13.bsb: Take all the fat that covers the entrails and the lobe of the liver, and both kidneys with the fat on them, and burn them on the altar.
Exo.29.13.kjv: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul that is above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and burn them upon the altar.

Exo.29.22.bsb: Take the fat from the ram, the fat tail, the fat covering the entrails, the lobe of the liver, both kidneys with the fat on them, and the right thigh (since this is a ram for ordination),
Exo.29.22.kjv: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder; for it is a ram of consecration:

Exo.21.7.bsb: And if a man sells his daughter as a servant, she is not to go free as the menservants do.
Exo.21.7.kjv: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.

Exo.21.8.bsb: If she is displeasing in the eyes of her master who had designated her for himself, he must allow her to be redeemed. He has no right to sell her to foreigners, since he has broken faith with her.
Exo.21.8.kjv: If she please not her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.

Exo.21.9.bsb: And if he chooses her for his son, he must deal with her as with a daughter.
Exo.21.9.kjv: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.

Exo.21.10.bsb: If he takes another wife, he must not reduce the food, clothing, or marital rights of his first wife.
Exo.21.10.kjv: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.

Exo.21.11.bsb: If, however, he does not provide her with these three things, she is free to go without monetary payment.
Exo.21.11.kjv: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.

Exo.1.22.bsb: Then Pharaoh commanded all his people: “Every son born to the Hebrews you must throw into the Nile, but every daughter you may allow to live.”
Exo.1.22.kjv: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.

Exo.12.29.bsb: Now at midnight the LORD struck down every firstborn male in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh, who sat on his throne, to the firstborn of the prisoner in the dungeon, as well as all the firstborn among the livestock.
Exo.12.29.kjv: And it came to pass, that at midnight the Lord smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.

Exo.22.22.bsb: You must not mistreat any widow or orphan.
Exo.22.22.kjv: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.

Exo.22.23.bsb: If you do mistreat them, and they cry out to Me in distress, I will surely hear their cry.
Exo.22.23.kjv: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;

Exo.20.12.bsb: Honor your father and mother, so that your days may be long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
Exo.20.12.kjv: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.

Exo.13.8.bsb: And on that day you are to explain to your son, ‘This is because of what the LORD did for me when I came out of Egypt.’
Exo.13.8.kjv: And thou shalt shew thy son in that day, saying, This is done because of that which the Lord did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt.

Exo.13.9.bsb: It shall be a sign for you on your hand and a reminder on your forehead that the Law of the LORD is to be on your lips. For with a mighty hand the LORD brought you out of Egypt.
Exo.13.9.kjv: And it shall be for a sign unto thee upon thine hand, and for a memorial between thine eyes, that the Lord’s law may be in thy mouth: for with a strong hand hath the Lord brought thee out of Egypt.

Exo.13.10.bsb: Therefore you shall keep this statute at the appointed time year after year.
Exo.13.10.kjv: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year.

Exo.13.14.bsb: In the future, when your son asks you, ‘What does this mean?’ you are to tell him, ‘With a mighty hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
Exo.13.14.kjv: And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What is this? that thou shalt say unto him, By strength of hand the Lord brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage:

Exo.13.15.bsb: And when Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, the LORD killed every firstborn in the land of Egypt, both of man and beast. This is why I sacrifice to the LORD the firstborn male of every womb, but I redeem all the firstborn of my sons.’
Exo.13.15.kjv: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that the Lord slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of beast: therefore I sacrifice to the Lord all that openeth the matrix, being males; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.

Exo.13.16.bsb: So it shall serve as a sign on your hand and a symbol on your forehead, for with a mighty hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt.”
Exo.13.16.kjv: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand, and for frontlets between thine eyes: for by strength of hand the Lord brought us forth out of Egypt.

Exo.21.15.bsb: Whoever strikes his father or mother must surely be put to death.
Exo.21.15.kjv: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.

Exo.21.17.bsb: Anyone who curses his father or mother must surely be put to death.
Exo.21.17.kjv: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.

Exo.15.2.bsb: The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation. He is my God, and I will praise Him, my father’s God, and I will exalt Him.
Exo.15.2.kjv: The Lord is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.

Exo.18.7.bsb: So Moses went out to meet his father-in-law and bowed down and kissed him. They greeted each other and went into the tent.
Exo.18.7.kjv: And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.

Exo.23.19.bsb: Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the LORD your God. You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.
Exo.23.19.kjv: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.

Exo.34.26.bsb: Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the LORD your God. You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.”
Exo.34.26.kjv: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.

Exo.25.8.bsb: And they are to make a sanctuary for Me, so that I may dwell among them.
Exo.25.8.kjv: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.

Exo.26.1.bsb: “You are to construct the tabernacle itself with ten curtains of finely spun linen, each with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and cherubim skillfully worked into them.
Exo.26.1.kjv: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them.

Exo.28.29.bsb: Whenever Aaron enters the Holy Place, he shall bear the names of the sons of Israel over his heart on the breastpiece of judgment, as a continual reminder before the LORD.
Exo.28.29.kjv: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goeth in unto the holy place, for a memorial before the Lord continually.

Exo.38.24.bsb: All the gold from the wave offering used for the work on the sanctuary totaled 29 talents and 730 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.
Exo.38.24.kjv: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy place, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

Exo.30.26.bsb: Use this oil to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony,
Exo.30.26.kjv: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,

Exo.30.27.bsb: the table and all its utensils, the lampstand and its utensils, the altar of incense,
Exo.30.27.kjv: And the table and all his vessels, and the candlestick and his vessels, and the altar of incense,

Exo.30.28.bsb: the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the basin with its stand.
Exo.30.28.kjv: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels, and the laver and his foot.

Exo.30.29.bsb: You are to consecrate them so that they will be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.
Exo.30.29.kjv: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.

Exo.40.9.bsb: Take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything in it; consecrate it along with all its furnishings, and it shall be holy.
Exo.40.9.kjv: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.

Exo.12.19.bsb: For seven days there must be no leaven found in your houses. If anyone eats something leavened, that person, whether a foreigner or native of the land, must be cut off from the congregation of Israel.
Exo.12.19.kjv: Seven days shall there be no leaven found in your houses: for whosoever eateth that which is leavened, even that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he be a stranger, or born in the land.

Exo.12.47.bsb: The whole congregation of Israel must celebrate it.
Exo.12.47.kjv: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.

Exo.16.1.bsb: On the fifteenth day of the second month after they had left the land of Egypt, the whole congregation of Israel set out from Elim and came to the Desert of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai.
Exo.16.1.kjv: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.

Exo.16.2.bsb: And there in the desert the whole congregation of Israel grumbled against Moses and Aaron.
Exo.16.2.kjv: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness:

Exo.16.9.bsb: Then Moses said to Aaron, “Tell the whole congregation of Israel, ‘Come before the LORD, for He has heard your grumbling.’”
Exo.16.9.kjv: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the Lord: for he hath heard your murmurings.

Exo.16.22.bsb: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much food—two omers per person—and all the leaders of the congregation came and reported this to Moses.
Exo.16.22.kjv: And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one man: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.

Exo.12.15.bsb: For seven days you must eat unleavened bread. On the first day you are to remove the leaven from your houses. Whoever eats anything leavened from the first day through the seventh must be cut off from Israel.
Exo.12.15.kjv: Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses: for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.

Exo.30.33.bsb: Anyone who mixes perfume like it or puts it on an outsider shall be cut off from his people.’”
Exo.30.33.kjv: Whosoever compoundeth any like it, or whosoever putteth any of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.

Exo.30.37.bsb: You are never to use this formula to make incense for yourselves; you shall regard it as holy to the LORD.
Exo.30.37.kjv: And as for the perfume which thou shalt make, ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto thee holy for the Lord.

Exo.30.38.bsb: Anyone who makes something like it to enjoy its fragrance shall be cut off from his people.”
Exo.30.38.kjv: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.

Exo.34.28.bsb: So Moses was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights without eating bread or drinking water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant—the Ten Commandments.
Exo.34.28.kjv: And he was there with the Lord forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

Exo.31.16.bsb: The Israelites must keep the Sabbath, celebrating it as a permanent covenant for the generations to come.
Exo.31.16.kjv: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.

Exo.6.4.bsb: I also established My covenant with them to give them the land of Canaan, the land where they lived as foreigners.
Exo.6.4.kjv: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were strangers.

Exo.6.5.bsb: Furthermore, I have heard the groaning of the Israelites, whom the Egyptians are enslaving, and I have remembered My covenant.
Exo.6.5.kjv: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.

Exo.6.6.bsb: Therefore tell the Israelites: ‘I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians and deliver you from their bondage. I will redeem you with an outstretched arm and with mighty acts of judgment.
Exo.6.6.kjv: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel, I am the Lord, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm, and with great judgments:

Exo.6.7.bsb: I will take you as My own people, and I will be your God. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, who brought you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians.
Exo.6.7.kjv: And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I am the Lord your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

Exo.6.8.bsb: And I will bring you into the land that I swore to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will give it to you as a possession. I am the LORD!’”
Exo.6.8.kjv: And I will bring you in unto the land, concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it you for an heritage: I am the Lord.

Exo.29.6.bsb: Put the turban on his head and attach the holy diadem to the turban.
Exo.29.6.kjv: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.

Exo.39.30.bsb: They also made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and they engraved on it, like an inscription on a seal: HOLY TO THE LORD.
Exo.39.30.kjv: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.

Exo.14.13.bsb: But Moses told the people, “Do not be afraid. Stand firm and you will see the LORD’s salvation, which He will accomplish for you today; for the Egyptians you see today, you will never see again.
Exo.14.13.kjv: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.

Exo.15.3.bsb: The LORD is a warrior, the LORD is His name.
Exo.15.3.kjv: The Lord is a man of war: the Lord is his name.

Exo.15.4.bsb: Pharaoh’s chariots and army He has cast into the sea; the finest of his officers are drowned in the Red Sea.
Exo.15.4.kjv: Pharaoh’s chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.

Exo.15.5.bsb: The depths have covered them; they sank there like a stone.
Exo.15.5.kjv: The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.

Exo.15.7.bsb: You overthrew Your adversaries by Your great majesty. You unleashed Your burning wrath; it consumed them like stubble.
Exo.15.7.kjv: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath, which consumed them as stubble.

Exo.15.8.bsb: At the blast of Your nostrils the waters piled up; like a wall the currents stood firm; the depths congealed in the heart of the sea.
Exo.15.8.kjv: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together, the floods stood upright as an heap, and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.

Exo.15.9.bsb: The enemy declared, ‘I will pursue, I will overtake. I will divide the spoils; I will gorge myself on them. I will draw my sword; my hand will destroy them.’
Exo.15.9.kjv: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.

Exo.15.10.bsb: But You blew with Your breath, and the sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.
Exo.15.10.kjv: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.

Exo.15.12.bsb: You stretched out Your right hand, and the earth swallowed them up.
Exo.15.12.kjv: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, the earth swallowed them.

Exo.15.13.bsb: With loving devotion You will lead the people You have redeemed; with Your strength You will guide them to Your holy dwelling.
Exo.15.13.kjv: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.

Exo.15.14.bsb: The nations will hear and tremble; anguish will grip the dwellers of Philistia.
Exo.15.14.kjv: The people shall hear, and be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.

Exo.15.15.bsb: Then the chiefs of Edom will be dismayed; trembling will seize the leaders of Moab; those who dwell in Canaan will melt away,
Exo.15.15.kjv: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.

Exo.15.16.bsb: and terror and dread will fall on them. By the power of Your arm they will be as still as a stone until Your people pass by, O LORD, until the people You have bought pass by.
Exo.15.16.kjv: Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be as still as a stone; till thy people pass over, O Lord, till the people pass over, which thou hast purchased.

Exo.15.17.bsb: You will bring them in and plant them on the mountain of Your inheritance—the place, O LORD, You have prepared for Your dwelling, the sanctuary, O Lord, Your hands have established.
Exo.15.17.kjv: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance, in the place, O Lord, which thou hast made for thee to dwell in, in the Sanctuary, O Lord, which thy hands have established.

Exo.15.18.bsb: The LORD will reign forever and ever!”
Exo.15.18.kjv: The Lord shall reign for ever and ever.

Exo.15.19.bsb: For when Pharaoh’s horses, chariots, and horsemen went into the sea, the LORD brought the waters of the sea back over them. But the Israelites walked through the sea on dry ground.
Exo.15.19.kjv: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the Lord brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of the sea.

Exo.18.11.bsb: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all other gods, for He did this when they treated Israel with arrogance.”
Exo.18.11.kjv: Now I know that the Lord is greater than all gods: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them.

Exo.2.2.bsb: and she conceived and gave birth to a son. When she saw that he was a beautiful child, she hid him for three months.
Exo.2.2.kjv: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he was a goodly child, she hid him three months.

Exo.9.20.bsb: Those among Pharaoh’s officials who feared the word of the LORD hurried to bring their servants and livestock to shelter,
Exo.9.20.kjv: He that feared the word of the Lord among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses:

Exo.3.11.bsb: But Moses asked God, “Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh and bring the Israelites out of Egypt?”
Exo.3.11.kjv: And Moses said unto God, Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?

Exo.3.12.bsb: “I will surely be with you,” God said, “and this will be the sign to you that I have sent you: When you have brought the people out of Egypt, all of you will worship God on this mountain.”
Exo.3.12.kjv: And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this shall be a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.

Exo.4.10.bsb: “Please, Lord,” Moses replied, “I have never been eloquent, neither in the past nor since You have spoken to Your servant, for I am slow of speech and tongue.”
Exo.4.10.kjv: And Moses said unto the Lord, O my Lord, I am not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant: but I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.

Exo.4.11.bsb: And the LORD said to him, “Who gave man his mouth? Or who makes the mute or the deaf, the sighted or the blind? Is it not I, the LORD?
Exo.4.11.kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Who hath made man’s mouth? or who maketh the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? have not I the Lord?

Exo.4.12.bsb: Now go! I will help you as you speak, and I will teach you what to say.”
Exo.4.12.kjv: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.

Exo.4.13.bsb: But Moses replied, “Please, Lord, send someone else.”
Exo.4.13.kjv: And he said, O my Lord, send, I pray thee, by the hand of him whom thou wilt send.

Exo.4.14.bsb: Then the anger of the LORD burned against Moses, and He said, “Is not Aaron the Levite your brother? I know that he can speak well, and he is now on his way to meet you. When he sees you, he will be glad in his heart.
Exo.4.14.kjv: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Moses, and he said, Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother? I know that he can speak well. And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.

Exo.4.15.bsb: You are to speak to him and put the words in his mouth. I will help both of you to speak, and I will teach you what to do.
Exo.4.15.kjv: And thou shalt speak unto him, and put words in his mouth: and I will be with thy mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what ye shall do.

Exo.4.16.bsb: He will speak to the people for you. He will be your spokesman, and it will be as if you were God to him.
Exo.4.16.kjv: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people: and he shall be, even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth, and thou shalt be to him instead of God.

Exo.4.17.bsb: But take this staff in your hand so you can perform signs with it.”
Exo.4.17.kjv: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand, wherewith thou shalt do signs.

Exo.4.25.bsb: But Zipporah took a flint knife, cut off her son’s foreskin, and touched it to Moses’ feet. “Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me,” she said.
Exo.4.25.kjv: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband art thou to me.

Exo.4.26.bsb: So the LORD let him alone. (When she said, “bridegroom of blood,” she was referring to the circumcision.)
Exo.4.26.kjv: So he let him go: then she said, A bloody husband thou art, because of the circumcision.

Exo.19.17.bsb: Then Moses brought the people out of the camp to meet with God, and they stood at the foot of the mountain.
Exo.19.17.kjv: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.

Exo.19.18.bsb: Mount Sinai was completely enveloped in smoke, because the LORD had descended on it in fire. And the smoke rose like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked violently.
Exo.19.18.kjv: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the Lord descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.

Exo.19.19.bsb: And as the sound of the ram’s horn grew louder and louder, Moses spoke and God answered him in the thunder.
Exo.19.19.kjv: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.

Exo.19.20.bsb: The LORD descended to the top of Mount Sinai and called Moses to the summit. So Moses went up,
Exo.19.20.kjv: And the Lord came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the Lord called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.

Exo.19.21.bsb: and the LORD said to him, “Go down and warn the people not to break through to see the LORD, lest many of them perish.
Exo.19.21.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the Lord to gaze, and many of them perish.

Exo.19.22.bsb: Even the priests who approach the LORD must consecrate themselves, or the LORD will break out against them.”
Exo.19.22.kjv: And let the priests also, which come near to the Lord, sanctify themselves, lest the Lord break forth upon them.

Exo.19.23.bsb: But Moses said to the LORD, “The people cannot come up Mount Sinai, for You solemnly warned us, ‘Put a boundary around the mountain and set it apart as holy.’”
Exo.19.23.kjv: And Moses said unto the Lord, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.

Exo.19.24.bsb: And the LORD replied, “Go down and bring Aaron with you. But the priests and the people must not break through to come up to the LORD, or He will break out against them.”
Exo.19.24.kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Away, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the Lord, lest he break forth upon them.

Exo.24.10.bsb: and they saw the God of Israel. Under His feet was a work like a pavement made of sapphire, as clear as the sky itself.
Exo.24.10.kjv: And they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.

Exo.34.14.bsb: For you must not worship any other god, for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.
Exo.34.14.kjv: For thou shalt worship no other god: for the Lord, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God:

Exo.6.3.bsb: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob as God Almighty, but by My name the LORD I did not make Myself known to them.
Exo.6.3.kjv: And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by the name of God Almighty, but by my name Jehovah was I not known to them.

Exo.3.15.bsb: God also told Moses, “Say to the Israelites, ‘The LORD, the God of your fathers—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob—has sent me to you.’ This is My name forever, and this is how I am to be remembered in every generation.
Exo.3.15.kjv: And God said moreover unto Moses, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, The Lord God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you: this is my name for ever, and this is my memorial unto all generations.

Exo.12.41.bsb: At the end of the 430 years, to the very day, all the LORD’s divisions went out of the land of Egypt.
Exo.12.41.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even the selfsame day it came to pass, that all the hosts of the Lord went out from the land of Egypt.

Exo.20.18.bsb: When all the people witnessed the thunder and lightning, the sounding of the ram’s horn, and the mountain enveloped in smoke, they trembled and stood at a distance.
Exo.20.18.kjv: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw it, they removed, and stood afar off.

Exo.20.19.bsb: “Speak to us yourself and we will listen,” they said to Moses. “But do not let God speak to us, or we will die.”
Exo.20.19.kjv: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.

Exo.34.29.bsb: And when Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hands, he was unaware that his face had become radiant from speaking with the LORD.
Exo.34.29.kjv: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.

Exo.34.30.bsb: Aaron and all the Israelites looked at Moses, and behold, his face was radiant. And they were afraid to approach him.
Exo.34.30.kjv: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.

Exo.34.31.bsb: But Moses called out to them; so Aaron and all the leaders of the congregation returned to him, and Moses spoke to them.
Exo.34.31.kjv: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.

Exo.34.32.bsb: And after this all the Israelites came near, and Moses commanded them to do everything that the LORD had told him on Mount Sinai.
Exo.34.32.kjv: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that the Lord had spoken with him in mount Sinai.

Exo.34.34.bsb: But whenever Moses went in before the LORD to speak with Him, he would remove the veil until he came out. And when he came out, he would tell the Israelites what he had been commanded,
Exo.34.34.kjv: But when Moses went in before the Lord to speak with him, he took the vail off, until he came out. And he came out, and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded.

Exo.34.35.bsb: and the Israelites would see that the face of Moses was radiant. So Moses would put the veil back over his face until he went in to speak with the LORD.
Exo.34.35.kjv: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone: and Moses put the vail upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.

Exo.20.21.bsb: And the people stood at a distance as Moses approached the thick darkness where God was.
Exo.20.21.kjv: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was.

Exo.24.2.bsb: Moses alone shall approach the LORD, but the others must not come near. And the people may not go up with him.”
Exo.24.2.kjv: And Moses alone shall come near the Lord: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.

Exo.33.11.bsb: Thus the LORD would speak to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. Then Moses would return to the camp, but his young assistant Joshua son of Nun would not leave the tent.
Exo.33.11.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.

Exo.33.12.bsb: Then Moses said to the LORD, “Look, You have been telling me, ‘Lead this people up,’ but You have not let me know whom You will send with me. Yet You have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have found favor in My sight.’
Exo.33.12.kjv: And Moses said unto the Lord, See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.

Exo.33.17.bsb: So the LORD said to Moses, “I will do this very thing you have asked, for you have found favor in My sight, and I know you by name.”
Exo.33.17.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.

Exo.33.13.bsb: Now if indeed I have found favor in Your sight, please let me know Your ways, that I may know You and find favor in Your sight. Remember that this nation is Your people.”
Exo.33.13.kjv: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight, shew me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight: and consider that this nation is thy people.

Exo.3.5.bsb: “Do not come any closer,” God said. “Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.”
Exo.3.5.kjv: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.

Exo.3.3.bsb: So Moses thought, “I must go over and see this marvelous sight. Why is the bush not burning up?”
Exo.3.3.kjv: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.

Exo.3.7.bsb: The LORD said, “I have indeed seen the affliction of My people in Egypt. I have heard them crying out because of their oppressors, and I am aware of their sufferings.
Exo.3.7.kjv: And the Lord said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;

Exo.3.9.bsb: And now the cry of the Israelites has reached Me, and I have seen how severely the Egyptians are oppressing them.
Exo.3.9.kjv: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me: and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.

Exo.3.19.bsb: But I know that the king of Egypt will not allow you to go unless a mighty hand compels him.
Exo.3.19.kjv: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand.

Exo.3.20.bsb: So I will stretch out My hand and strike the Egyptians with all the wonders I will perform among them. And after that, he will release you.
Exo.3.20.kjv: And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go.

Exo.6.1.bsb: But the LORD said to Moses, “Now you will see what I will do to Pharaoh, for because of My mighty hand he will let the people go; because of My strong hand he will drive them out of his land.”
Exo.6.1.kjv: Then the Lord said unto Moses, Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.

Exo.11.1.bsb: Then the LORD said to Moses, “I will bring upon Pharaoh and Egypt one more plague. After that, he will allow you to leave this place. And when he lets you go, he will drive you out completely.
Exo.11.1.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Yet will I bring one plague more upon Pharaoh, and upon Egypt; afterwards he will let you go hence: when he shall let you go, he shall surely thrust you out hence altogether.

Exo.14.3.bsb: For Pharaoh will say of the Israelites, ‘They are wandering the land in confusion; the wilderness has boxed them in.’
Exo.14.3.kjv: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They are entangled in the land, the wilderness hath shut them in.

Exo.14.4.bsb: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart so that he will pursue them. But I will gain honor by means of Pharaoh and all his army, and the Egyptians will know that I am the LORD.” So this is what the Israelites did.
Exo.14.4.kjv: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host; that the Egyptians may know that I am the Lord. And they did so.

Exo.3.6.bsb: Then He said, “I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.” At this, Moses hid his face, for he was afraid to look at God.
Exo.3.6.kjv: Moreover he said, I am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.

Exo.19.4.bsb: ‘You have seen for yourselves what I did to Egypt, and how I carried you on eagles’ wings and brought you to Myself.
Exo.19.4.kjv: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles’ wings, and brought you unto myself.

Exo.19.5.bsb: Now if you will indeed obey My voice and keep My covenant, you will be My treasured possession out of all the nations—for the whole earth is Mine.
Exo.19.5.kjv: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine:

Exo.19.6.bsb: And unto Me you shall be a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words that you are to speak to the Israelites.”
Exo.19.6.kjv: And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.

Exo.29.45.bsb: Then I will dwell among the Israelites and be their God.
Exo.29.45.kjv: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.

Exo.29.46.bsb: And they will know that I am the LORD their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt so that I might dwell among them. I am the LORD their God.
Exo.29.46.kjv: And they shall know that I am the Lord their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am the Lord their God.

Exo.2.25.bsb: God saw the Israelites and took notice.
Exo.2.25.kjv: And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto them.

Exo.20.2.bsb: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
Exo.20.2.kjv: I am the Lord thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

Exo.20.6.bsb: but showing loving devotion to a thousand generations of those who love Me and keep My commandments.
Exo.20.6.kjv: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.

Exo.20.22.bsb: Then the LORD said to Moses, “This is what you are to tell the Israelites: ‘You have seen for yourselves that I have spoken to you from heaven.
Exo.20.22.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

Exo.22.27.bsb: because his cloak is the only covering he has for his body. What else will he sleep in? And if he cries out to Me, I will hear, for I am compassionate.
Exo.22.27.kjv: For that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.

Exo.25.17.bsb: And you are to construct a mercy seat of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
Exo.25.17.kjv: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

Exo.3.14.bsb: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM. This is what you are to say to the Israelites: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”
Exo.3.14.kjv: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.

Exo.8.10.bsb: “Tomorrow,” Pharaoh answered. “May it be as you say,” Moses replied, “so that you may know that there is no one like the LORD our God.
Exo.8.10.kjv: And he said, To morrow. And he said, Be it according to thy word: that thou mayest know that there is none like unto the Lord our God.

Exo.20.3.bsb: You shall have no other gods before Me.
Exo.20.3.kjv: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

Exo.3.17.bsb: And I have promised to bring you up out of your affliction in Egypt, into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites—a land flowing with milk and honey.’
Exo.3.17.kjv: And I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, unto a land flowing with milk and honey.

Exo.8.22.bsb: But on that day I will give special treatment to the land of Goshen, where My people live; no swarms of flies will be found there. In this way you will know that I, the LORD, am in the land.
Exo.8.22.kjv: And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there; to the end thou mayest know that I am the Lord in the midst of the earth.

Exo.8.23.bsb: I will make a distinction between My people and your people. This sign will take place tomorrow.’”
Exo.8.23.kjv: And I will put a division between my people and thy people: to morrow shall this sign be.

Exo.9.26.bsb: The only place where it did not hail was in the land of Goshen, where the Israelites lived.
Exo.9.26.kjv: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, was there no hail.

Exo.11.7.bsb: But among all the Israelites, not even a dog will snarl at man or beast.’ Then you will know that the LORD makes a distinction between Egypt and Israel.
