Exo.39.1.bsb: From the blue, purple, and scarlet yarn they made specially woven garments for ministry in the sanctuary, as well as the holy garments for Aaron, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Exo.39.1.kjv: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the Lord commanded Moses.

Exo.39.2.bsb: Bezalel made the ephod of finely spun linen embroidered with gold, and with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn.
Exo.39.2.kjv: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

Exo.39.3.bsb: They hammered out thin sheets of gold and cut threads from them to interweave with the blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine linen—the work of a skilled craftsman.
Exo.39.3.kjv: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.

Exo.39.4.bsb: They made shoulder pieces for the ephod, which were attached at two of its corners, so it could be fastened.
Exo.39.4.kjv: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.

Exo.39.5.bsb: And the skillfully woven waistband of the ephod was of one piece with the ephod, of the same workmanship—with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Exo.39.5.kjv: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that was upon it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the Lord commanded Moses.

Exo.39.6.bsb: They mounted the onyx stones in gold filigree settings, engraved like a seal with the names of the sons of Israel.
Exo.39.6.kjv: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.

Exo.39.7.bsb: Then they fastened them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Exo.39.7.kjv: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the Lord commanded Moses.

Exo.39.8.bsb: He made the breastpiece with the same workmanship as the ephod, with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen.
Exo.39.8.kjv: And he made the breastplate of cunning work, like the work of the ephod; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

Exo.39.9.bsb: It was square when folded over double, a span long and a span wide.
Exo.39.9.kjv: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.

Exo.39.10.bsb: And they mounted on it four rows of gemstones: The first row had a ruby, a topaz, and an emerald;
Exo.39.10.kjv: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.

Exo.39.11.bsb: the second row had a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
Exo.39.11.kjv: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

Exo.39.12.bsb: the third row had a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
Exo.39.12.kjv: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.

Exo.39.13.bsb: and the fourth row had a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. These stones were mounted in gold filigree settings.
Exo.39.13.kjv: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.

Exo.39.14.bsb: The twelve stones corresponded to the names of the sons of Israel. Each stone was engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.
Exo.39.14.kjv: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.

Exo.39.15.bsb: For the breastpiece they made braided chains like cords of pure gold.
Exo.39.15.kjv: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, of wreathen work of pure gold.

Exo.39.16.bsb: They also made two gold filigree settings and two gold rings, and fastened the two rings to the two corners of the breastpiece.
Exo.39.16.kjv: And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.

Exo.39.17.bsb: Then they fastened the two gold chains to the two gold rings at the corners of the breastpiece,
Exo.39.17.kjv: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.

Exo.39.18.bsb: and they fastened the other ends of the two chains to the two filigree settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.
Exo.39.18.kjv: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.

Exo.39.19.bsb: They made two more gold rings and attached them to the other two corners of the breastpiece, on the inside edge next to the ephod.
Exo.39.19.kjv: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward.

Exo.39.20.bsb: They made two additional gold rings and attached them to the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, on its front, near the seam just above its woven waistband.
Exo.39.20.kjv: And they made two other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.

Exo.39.21.bsb: Then they tied the rings of the breastpiece to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue yarn, so that the breastpiece was above the waistband of the ephod and would not swing out from the ephod, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Exo.39.21.kjv: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the Lord commanded Moses.

Exo.39.22.bsb: They made the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth, the work of a weaver,
Exo.39.22.kjv: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

Exo.39.23.bsb: with an opening in the center of the robe like that of a garment, with a collar around the opening so that it would not tear.
Exo.39.23.kjv: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.

Exo.39.24.bsb: They made pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and finely spun linen on the lower hem of the robe.
Exo.39.24.kjv: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.

Exo.39.25.bsb: They also made bells of pure gold and attached them around the hem between the pomegranates,
Exo.39.25.kjv: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;

Exo.39.26.bsb: alternating the bells and pomegranates around the lower hem of the robe to be worn for ministry, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Exo.39.26.kjv: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as the Lord commanded Moses.

Exo.39.27.bsb: For Aaron and his sons they made tunics of fine linen, the work of a weaver,
Exo.39.27.kjv: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,

Exo.27.20.bsb: And you are to command the Israelites to bring you pure oil of pressed olives for the light, to keep the lamps burning continually.
Exo.27.20.kjv: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.

Exo.25.30.bsb: And place the Bread of the Presence on the table before Me at all times.
Exo.25.30.kjv: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.

Exo.30.8.bsb: When Aaron sets up the lamps at twilight, he must burn the incense perpetually before the LORD for the generations to come.
Exo.30.8.kjv: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the Lord throughout your generations.

Exo.30.7.bsb: And Aaron is to burn fragrant incense on it every morning when he tends the lamps.
Exo.30.7.kjv: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.

Exo.30.10.bsb: Once a year Aaron shall make atonement on the horns of the altar. Throughout your generations he shall make atonement on it annually with the blood of the sin offering of atonement. The altar is most holy to the LORD.”
Exo.30.10.kjv: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it is most holy unto the Lord.

Exo.4.27.bsb: Meanwhile, the LORD had said to Aaron, “Go and meet Moses in the wilderness.” So he went and met Moses at the mountain of God and kissed him.
Exo.4.27.kjv: And the Lord said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went, and met him in the mount of God, and kissed him.

Exo.6.13.bsb: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron and gave them a charge concerning both the Israelites and Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the Israelites out of the land of Egypt.
Exo.6.13.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

Exo.6.29.bsb: He said to him, “I am the LORD; tell Pharaoh king of Egypt everything I say to you.”
Exo.6.29.kjv: That the Lord spake unto Moses, saying, I am the Lord: speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee.

Exo.7.2.bsb: You are to speak all that I command you, and your brother Aaron is to tell Pharaoh to let the Israelites go out of his land.
Exo.7.2.kjv: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee: and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh, that he send the children of Israel out of his land.

Exo.25.9.bsb: You must make the tabernacle and design all its furnishings according to the pattern I show you.
Exo.25.9.kjv: According to all that I shew thee, after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make it.

Exo.25.22.bsb: And I will meet with you there above the mercy seat, between the two cherubim that are over the ark of the Testimony; I will speak with you about all that I command you regarding the Israelites.
Exo.25.22.kjv: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.

Exo.26.30.bsb: So you are to set up the tabernacle according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.
Exo.26.30.kjv: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shewed thee in the mount.

Exo.35.35.bsb: He has filled them with skill to do all kinds of work as engravers, designers, embroiderers in blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine linen, and as weavers—as artistic designers of every kind of craft.
Exo.35.35.kjv: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the cunning workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any work, and of those that devise cunning work.

Exo.19.15.bsb: “Be prepared for the third day,” he said to the people. “Do not draw near to a woman.”
Exo.19.15.kjv: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives.

Exo.19.14.bsb: When Moses came down from the mountain to the people, he consecrated them, and they washed their clothes.
Exo.19.14.kjv: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.

Exo.30.20.bsb: Whenever they enter the Tent of Meeting or approach the altar to minister by presenting a food offering to the LORD, they must wash with water so that they will not die.
Exo.30.20.kjv: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto the Lord:

Exo.30.21.bsb: Thus they are to wash their hands and feet so that they will not die; this shall be a permanent statute for Aaron and his descendants for the generations to come.”
Exo.30.21.kjv: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.

Exo.30.11.bsb: Then the LORD said to Moses,
Exo.30.11.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

Exo.30.12.bsb: “When you take a census of the Israelites to number them, each man must pay the LORD a ransom for his life when he is counted. Then no plague will come upon them when they are numbered.
Exo.30.12.kjv: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the Lord, when thou numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when thou numberest them.

Exo.30.13.bsb: Everyone who crosses over to those counted must pay a half shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs. This half shekel is an offering to the LORD.
Exo.30.13.kjv: This they shall give, every one that passeth among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel is twenty gerahs:) an half shekel shall be the offering of the Lord.

Exo.30.14.bsb: Everyone twenty years of age or older who crosses over must give this offering to the LORD.
Exo.30.14.kjv: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering unto the Lord.

Exo.30.16.bsb: Take the atonement money from the Israelites and use it for the service of the Tent of Meeting. It will serve as a memorial for the Israelites before the LORD to make atonement for your lives.”
Exo.30.16.kjv: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the Lord, to make an atonement for your souls.

Exo.38.26.bsb: a beka per person, that is, half a shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, from everyone twenty years of age or older who had crossed over to be numbered, a total of 603,550 men.
Exo.38.26.kjv: A bekah for every man, that is, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.

Exo.3.4.bsb: When the LORD saw that he had gone over to look, God called out to him from within the bush, “Moses, Moses!” “Here I am,” he answered.
Exo.3.4.kjv: And when the Lord saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.

Exo.3.13.bsb: Then Moses asked God, “Suppose I go to the Israelites and say to them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me to you,’ and they ask me, ‘What is His name?’ What should I tell them?”
Exo.3.13.kjv: And Moses said unto God, Behold, when I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What is his name? what shall I say unto them?

Exo.3.21.bsb: And I will grant this people such favor in the sight of the Egyptians that when you leave, you will not go away empty-handed.
Exo.3.21.kjv: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go, ye shall not go empty:

Exo.3.22.bsb: Every woman shall ask her neighbor and any woman staying in her house for silver and gold jewelry and clothing, and you will put them on your sons and daughters. So you will plunder the Egyptians.”
Exo.3.22.kjv: But every woman shall borrow of her neighbour, and of her that sojourneth in her house, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment: and ye shall put them upon your sons, and upon your daughters; and ye shall spoil the Egyptians.

Exo.9.27.bsb: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron. “This time I have sinned,” he said. “The LORD is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.
Exo.9.27.kjv: And Pharaoh sent, and called for Moses and Aaron, and said unto them, I have sinned this time: the Lord is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.

Exo.10.16.bsb: Pharaoh quickly summoned Moses and Aaron and said, “I have sinned against the LORD your God and against you.
Exo.10.16.kjv: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste; and he said, I have sinned against the Lord your God, and against you.

Exo.10.17.bsb: Now please forgive my sin once more and appeal to the LORD your God, that He may remove this death from me.”
Exo.10.17.kjv: Now therefore forgive, I pray thee, my sin only this once, and intreat the Lord your God, that he may take away from me this death only.

Exo.33.3.bsb: Go up to a land flowing with milk and honey. But I will not go with you, because you are a stiff-necked people; otherwise, I might destroy you on the way.”
Exo.33.3.kjv: Unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou art a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee in the way.

Exo.21.1.bsb: “These are the ordinances that you are to set before them:
Exo.21.1.kjv: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them.

Exo.21.2.bsb: If you buy a Hebrew servant, he is to serve you for six years. But in the seventh year, he shall go free without paying anything.
Exo.21.2.kjv: If thou buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.

Exo.21.3.bsb: If he arrived alone, he is to leave alone; if he arrived with a wife, she is to leave with him.
Exo.21.3.kjv: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.

Exo.21.4.bsb: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the woman and her children shall belong to her master, and only the man shall go free.
Exo.21.4.kjv: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.

Exo.21.5.bsb: But if the servant declares, ‘I love my master and my wife and children; I do not want to go free,’
Exo.21.5.kjv: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:

Exo.21.6.bsb: then his master is to bring him before the judges. And he shall take him to the door or doorpost and pierce his ear with an awl. Then he shall serve his master for life.
Exo.21.6.kjv: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.

Exo.21.21.bsb: However, if the servant gets up after a day or two, the owner shall not be punished, since the servant is his property.
Exo.21.21.kjv: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.

Exo.21.26.bsb: If a man strikes and blinds the eye of his manservant or maidservant, he must let the servant go free as compensation for the eye.
Exo.21.26.kjv: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.

Exo.21.27.bsb: And if he knocks out the tooth of his manservant or maidservant, he must let the servant go free as compensation for the tooth.
Exo.21.27.kjv: And if he smite out his manservant’s tooth, or his maidservant’s tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth’s sake.

Exo.21.32.bsb: If the ox gores a manservant or maidservant, the owner must pay thirty shekels of silver to the master of that servant, and the ox must be stoned.
Exo.21.32.kjv: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.

Exo.22.3.bsb: But if it happens after sunrise, there is guilt for his bloodshed. A thief must make full restitution; if he has nothing, he himself shall be sold for his theft.
Exo.22.3.kjv: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be blood shed for him; for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

Exo.12.44.bsb: But any slave who has been purchased may eat of it, after you have circumcised him.
Exo.12.44.kjv: But every man’s servant that is bought for money, when thou hast circumcised him, then shall he eat thereof.

Exo.23.12.bsb: For six days you are to do your work, but on the seventh day you must cease, so that your ox and your donkey may rest and the son of your maidservant may be refreshed, as well as the foreign resident.
Exo.23.12.kjv: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.

Exo.16.3.bsb: “If only we had died by the LORD’s hand in the land of Egypt!” they said. “There we sat by pots of meat and ate our fill of bread, but you have brought us into this desert to starve this whole assembly to death!”
Exo.16.3.kjv: And the children of Israel said unto them, Would to God we had died by the hand of the Lord in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots, and when we did eat bread to the full; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.

Exo.1.8.bsb: Then a new king, who did not know Joseph, came to power in Egypt.
Exo.1.8.kjv: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.

Exo.1.13.kjv: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:

Exo.1.14.bsb: and made their lives bitter with hard labor in brick and mortar, and with all kinds of work in the fields. Every service they imposed was harsh.
Exo.1.14.kjv: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.

Exo.1.15.bsb: Then the king of Egypt said to the Hebrew midwives, whose names were Shiphrah and Puah,
Exo.1.15.kjv: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:

Exo.1.16.bsb: “When you help the Hebrew women give birth, observe them on the birthstools. If the child is a son, kill him; but if it is a daughter, let her live.”
Exo.1.16.kjv: And he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the stools; if it be a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it be a daughter, then she shall live.

Exo.1.17.bsb: The midwives, however, feared God and did not do as the king of Egypt had instructed; they let the boys live.
Exo.1.17.kjv: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.

Exo.1.18.bsb: So the king of Egypt summoned the midwives and asked them, “Why have you done this? Why have you let the boys live?”
Exo.1.18.kjv: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?

Exo.1.19.bsb: The midwives answered Pharaoh, “The Hebrew women are not like the Egyptian women, for they are vigorous and give birth before a midwife arrives.”
Exo.1.19.kjv: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women; for they are lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.

Exo.1.20.bsb: So God was good to the midwives, and the people multiplied and became even more numerous.
Exo.1.20.kjv: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.

Exo.1.21.bsb: And because the midwives feared God, He gave them families of their own.
Exo.1.21.kjv: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.

Exo.5.7.bsb: “You shall no longer supply the people with straw for making bricks. They must go and gather their own straw.
Exo.5.7.kjv: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as heretofore: let them go and gather straw for themselves.

Exo.5.8.bsb: But require of them the same quota of bricks as before; do not reduce it. For they are lazy; that is why they are crying out, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to our God.’
Exo.5.8.kjv: And the tale of the bricks, which they did make heretofore, ye shall lay upon them; ye shall not diminish ought thereof: for they be idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go and sacrifice to our God.

Exo.5.9.bsb: Make the work harder on the men so they will be occupied and pay no attention to these lies.”
Exo.5.9.kjv: Let there more work be laid upon the men, that they may labour therein; and let them not regard vain words.

Exo.5.10.bsb: So the taskmasters and foremen of the people went out and said to them, “This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I am no longer giving you straw.
Exo.5.10.kjv: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spake to the people, saying, Thus saith Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.

Exo.5.11.bsb: Go and get your own straw wherever you can find it; but your workload will in no way be reduced.’”
Exo.5.11.kjv: Go ye, get you straw where ye can find it: yet not ought of your work shall be diminished.

Exo.5.12.bsb: So the people scattered all over the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.
Exo.5.12.kjv: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.

Exo.5.13.bsb: The taskmasters kept pressing them, saying, “Fulfill your quota each day, just as you did when straw was provided.”
Exo.5.13.kjv: And the taskmasters hasted them, saying, Fulfil your works, your daily tasks, as when there was straw.

Exo.5.14.bsb: Then the Israelite foremen, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over the people, were beaten and asked, “Why have you not fulfilled your quota of bricks yesterday or today, as you did before?”
Exo.5.14.kjv: And the officers of the children of Israel, which Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and demanded, Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day, as heretofore?

Exo.16.8.bsb: And Moses added, “The LORD will give you meat to eat this evening and bread to fill you in the morning, for He has heard your grumbling against Him. Who are we? Your grumblings are not against us but against the LORD.”
Exo.16.8.kjv: And Moses said, This shall be, when the Lord shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that the Lord heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him: and what are we? your murmurings are not against us, but against the Lord.

Exo.16.12.bsb: “I have heard the grumbling of the Israelites. Tell them, ‘At twilight you will eat meat, and in the morning you will be filled with bread. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God.’”
Exo.16.12.kjv: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel: speak unto them, saying, At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread; and ye shall know that I am the Lord your God.

Exo.32.33.bsb: The LORD replied to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against Me, I will blot out of My book.
Exo.32.33.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.

Exo.16.4.bsb: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I will rain down bread from heaven for you. Each day the people are to go out and gather enough for that day. In this way I will test whether or not they will follow My instructions.
Exo.16.4.kjv: Then said the Lord unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.

Exo.16.5.bsb: Then on the sixth day, when they prepare what they bring in, it will be twice as much as they gather on the other days.”
Exo.16.5.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare that which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.

Exo.16.6.bsb: So Moses and Aaron said to all the Israelites, “This evening you will know that it was the LORD who brought you out of the land of Egypt,
Exo.16.6.kjv: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel, At even, then ye shall know that the Lord hath brought you out from the land of Egypt:

Exo.16.7.bsb: and in the morning you will see the LORD’s glory, because He has heard your grumbling against Him. For who are we, that you should grumble against us?”
Exo.16.7.kjv: And in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of the Lord; for that he heareth your murmurings against the Lord: and what are we, that ye murmur against us?

Exo.16.11.bsb: Then the LORD said to Moses,
Exo.16.11.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

Exo.16.16.bsb: This is what the LORD has commanded: ‘Each one is to gather as much as he needs. You may take an omer for each person in your tent.’”
Exo.16.16.kjv: This is the thing which the Lord hath commanded, Gather of it every man according to his eating, an omer for every man, according to the number of your persons; take ye every man for them which are in his tents.

Exo.16.17.bsb: So the Israelites did this. Some gathered more, and some less.
Exo.16.17.kjv: And the children of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, some less.

Exo.16.18.bsb: When they measured it by the omer, he who gathered much had no excess, and he who gathered little had no shortfall. Each one gathered as much as he needed to eat.
Exo.16.18.kjv: And when they did mete it with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating.

Exo.16.19.bsb: Then Moses said to them, “No one may keep any of it until morning.”
Exo.16.19.kjv: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.

Exo.16.20.bsb: But they did not listen to Moses; some people left part of it until morning, and it became infested with maggots and began to smell. So Moses was angry with them.
Exo.16.20.kjv: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was wroth with them.

Exo.16.21.bsb: Every morning each one gathered as much as was needed, and when the sun grew hot, it melted away.
Exo.16.21.kjv: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.

Exo.16.23.bsb: He told them, “This is what the LORD has said: ‘Tomorrow is to be a day of complete rest, a holy Sabbath to the LORD. So bake what you want to bake, and boil what you want to boil. Then set aside whatever remains and keep it until morning.’”
Exo.16.23.kjv: And he said unto them, This is that which the Lord hath said, To morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto the Lord: bake that which ye will bake to day, and seethe that ye will seethe; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.

Exo.16.24.bsb: So they set it aside until morning as Moses had commanded, and it did not smell or contain any maggots.
Exo.16.24.kjv: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm therein.

Exo.16.25.bsb: “Eat it today,” Moses said, “because today is a Sabbath to the LORD. Today you will not find anything in the field.
Exo.16.25.kjv: And Moses said, Eat that to day; for to day is a sabbath unto the Lord: to day ye shall not find it in the field.

Exo.16.26.bsb: For six days you may gather, but on the seventh day, the Sabbath, it will not be there.”
Exo.16.26.kjv: Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day, which is the sabbath, in it there shall be none.

Exo.16.27.bsb: Yet on the seventh day some of the people went out to gather, but they did not find anything.
Exo.16.27.kjv: And it came to pass, that there went out some of the people on the seventh day for to gather, and they found none.

Exo.16.28.bsb: Then the LORD said to Moses, “How long will you refuse to keep My commandments and instructions?
Exo.16.28.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?

Exo.16.29.bsb: Understand that the LORD has given you the Sabbath; that is why on the sixth day He will give you bread for two days. On the seventh day, everyone must stay where he is; no one may leave his place.”
Exo.16.29.kjv: See, for that the Lord hath given you the sabbath, therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.

Exo.16.30.bsb: So the people rested on the seventh day.
Exo.16.30.kjv: So the people rested on the seventh day.

Exo.16.31.bsb: Now the house of Israel called the bread manna. It was white like coriander seed and tasted like wafers made with honey.
Exo.16.31.kjv: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.

Exo.16.33.bsb: So Moses told Aaron, “Take a jar and fill it with an omer of manna. Then place it before the LORD to be preserved for the generations to come.”
Exo.16.33.kjv: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before the Lord, to be kept for your generations.

Exo.16.34.bsb: And Aaron placed it in front of the Testimony, to be preserved just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Exo.16.34.kjv: As the Lord commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.

Exo.16.35.bsb: The Israelites ate manna forty years, until they came to a land where they could settle; they ate manna until they reached the border of Canaan.
Exo.16.35.kjv: And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they did eat manna, until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan.

Exo.16.36.bsb: (Now an omer is a tenth of an ephah.)
Exo.16.36.kjv: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.

Exo.33.7.bsb: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it at a distance outside the camp. He called it the Tent of Meeting, and anyone inquiring of the LORD would go to the Tent of Meeting outside the camp.
Exo.33.7.kjv: And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation. And it came to pass, that every one which sought the Lord went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation, which was without the camp.

Exo.33.8.bsb: Then, whenever Moses went out to the tent, all the people would stand at the entrances to their own tents and watch Moses until he entered the tent.
Exo.33.8.kjv: And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the tabernacle, that all the people rose up, and stood every man at his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the tabernacle.

Exo.38.21.bsb: This is the inventory for the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the Testimony, as recorded at Moses’ command by the Levites under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
Exo.38.21.kjv: This is the sum of the tabernacle, even of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.

Exo.39.32.bsb: So all the work for the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, was completed. The Israelites did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Exo.39.32.kjv: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so did they.

Exo.39.42.bsb: The Israelites had done all the work just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Exo.39.42.kjv: According to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.

Exo.39.43.bsb: And Moses inspected all the work and saw that they had accomplished it just as the LORD had commanded. So Moses blessed them.
Exo.39.43.kjv: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as the Lord had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.

Exo.38.25.bsb: The silver from those numbered among the congregation totaled 100 talents and 1,775 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel—
Exo.38.25.kjv: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

Exo.38.27.bsb: The hundred talents of silver were used to cast the bases of the sanctuary and the bases of the veil—100 bases from the 100 talents, one talent per base.
Exo.38.27.kjv: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.

Exo.38.28.bsb: With the 1,775 shekels of silver he made the hooks for the posts, overlaid their tops, and supplied bands for them.
Exo.38.28.kjv: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their chapiters, and filleted them.

Exo.38.29.bsb: The bronze from the wave offering totaled 70 talents and 2,400 shekels.
Exo.38.29.kjv: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.

Exo.38.30.bsb: He used it to make the bases for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar and its bronze grating, all the utensils for the altar,
Exo.38.30.kjv: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,

Exo.38.31.bsb: the bases for the surrounding courtyard and its gate, and all the tent pegs for the tabernacle and its surrounding courtyard.
Exo.38.31.kjv: And the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.

Exo.31.1.bsb: Then the LORD said to Moses,
Exo.31.1.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

Exo.31.2.bsb: “See, I have called by name Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
Exo.31.2.kjv: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:

Exo.31.4.bsb: to design artistic works in gold, silver, and bronze,
Exo.31.4.kjv: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,

Exo.31.5.bsb: to cut gemstones for settings, and to carve wood, so that he may be a master of every craft.
Exo.31.5.kjv: And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.

Exo.31.6.bsb: Moreover, I have selected Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, as his assistant. I have also given skill to all the craftsmen, that they may fashion all that I have commanded you:
Exo.31.6.kjv: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee;

Exo.31.7.bsb: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony and the mercy seat upon it, and all the other furnishings of the tent—
Exo.31.7.kjv: The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,

Exo.31.8.bsb: the table with its utensils, the pure gold lampstand with all its utensils, the altar of incense,
Exo.31.8.kjv: And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense,

Exo.31.9.bsb: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its stand—
Exo.31.9.kjv: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot,

Exo.31.10.bsb: as well as the woven garments, both the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons to serve as priests,
Exo.31.10.kjv: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office,

Exo.31.11.bsb: in addition to the anointing oil and fragrant incense for the Holy Place. They are to make them according to all that I have commanded you.”
Exo.31.11.kjv: And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.

Exo.35.30.bsb: Then Moses said to the Israelites, “See, the LORD has called by name Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
Exo.35.30.kjv: And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, the Lord hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;

Exo.35.32.bsb: to design artistic works in gold, silver, and bronze,
Exo.35.32.kjv: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,

Exo.35.33.bsb: to cut gemstones for settings, and to carve wood, so that he may be a master of every artistic craft.
Exo.35.33.kjv: And in the cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work.

Exo.35.34.bsb: And the LORD has given both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, the ability to teach others.
Exo.35.34.kjv: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

Exo.26.15.bsb: You are to construct upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
Exo.26.15.kjv: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up.

Exo.26.16.bsb: Each frame is to be ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
Exo.26.16.kjv: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.

Exo.26.17.bsb: Two tenons must be connected to each other for each frame. Make all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.
Exo.26.17.kjv: Two tenons shall there be in one board, set in order one against another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

Exo.26.18.bsb: Construct twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle,
Exo.26.18.kjv: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.

Exo.26.19.bsb: with forty silver bases under the twenty frames—two bases for each frame, one under each tenon.
Exo.26.19.kjv: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.

Exo.26.20.bsb: For the second side of the tabernacle, the north side, make twenty frames
Exo.26.20.kjv: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards:

Exo.26.21.bsb: and forty silver bases—two bases under each frame.
Exo.26.21.kjv: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

Exo.26.22.bsb: Make six frames for the rear of the tabernacle, the west side,
Exo.26.22.kjv: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.

Exo.26.23.bsb: and two frames for the two back corners of the tabernacle,
Exo.26.23.kjv: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.

Exo.26.24.bsb: coupled together from bottom to top and fitted into a single ring. These will serve as the two corners.
Exo.26.24.kjv: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.

Exo.26.25.bsb: So there are to be eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.
Exo.26.25.kjv: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

Exo.26.26.bsb: You are also to make five crossbars of acacia wood for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,
Exo.26.26.kjv: And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

Exo.26.27.bsb: five for those on the other side, and five for those on the rear side of the tabernacle, to the west.
Exo.26.27.kjv: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.

Exo.26.28.bsb: The central crossbar in the middle of the frames shall extend from one end to the other.
Exo.26.28.kjv: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.

Exo.26.29.bsb: Overlay the frames with gold and make gold rings to hold the crossbars. Also overlay the crossbars with gold.
Exo.26.29.kjv: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.

Exo.26.31.bsb: Make a veil of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen, with cherubim skillfully worked into it.
Exo.26.31.kjv: And thou shalt make a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen of cunning work: with cherubims shall it be made:

Exo.26.32.bsb: Hang it with gold hooks on four posts of acacia wood, overlaid with gold and standing on four silver bases.
Exo.26.32.kjv: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold: their hooks shall be of gold, upon the four sockets of silver.

Exo.26.33.bsb: And hang the veil from the clasps and place the ark of the Testimony behind the veil. So the veil will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.
Exo.26.33.kjv: And thou shalt hang up the vail under the taches, that thou mayest bring in thither within the vail the ark of the testimony: and the vail shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy.

Exo.26.34.bsb: Put the mercy seat on the ark of the Testimony in the Most Holy Place.
Exo.26.34.kjv: And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.

Exo.26.35.bsb: And place the table outside the veil on the north side of the tabernacle, and put the lampstand opposite the table, on the south side.
Exo.26.35.kjv: And thou shalt set the table without the vail, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.

Exo.26.36.bsb: For the entrance to the tent, you are to make a curtain embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen.
Exo.26.36.kjv: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework.

Exo.26.37.bsb: Make five posts of acacia wood for the curtain, overlay them with gold, use hooks of gold, and cast five bronze bases for them.
Exo.26.37.kjv: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, and their hooks shall be of gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.

Exo.36.20.bsb: Next, he constructed upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
Exo.36.20.kjv: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up.

Exo.36.21.bsb: Each frame was ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
Exo.36.21.kjv: The length of a board was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.

Exo.36.22.bsb: Two tenons were connected to each other for each frame. He made all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.
Exo.36.22.kjv: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

Exo.36.23.bsb: He constructed twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle,
Exo.36.23.kjv: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:

Exo.36.24.bsb: with forty silver bases to put under the twenty frames—two bases for each frame, one under each tenon.
Exo.36.24.kjv: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.

Exo.36.25.bsb: For the second side of the tabernacle, the north side, he made twenty frames
Exo.36.25.kjv: And for the other side of the tabernacle, which is toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,

Exo.36.26.bsb: and forty silver bases—two bases under each frame.
Exo.36.26.kjv: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

Exo.36.27.bsb: He made six frames for the rear of the tabernacle, the west side,
Exo.36.27.kjv: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

Exo.36.28.bsb: and two frames for the two back corners of the tabernacle,
Exo.36.28.kjv: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.

Exo.36.29.bsb: coupled together from bottom to top and fitted into a single ring. He made both corners in this way.
Exo.36.29.kjv: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.

Exo.36.30.bsb: So there were eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.
Exo.36.30.kjv: And there were eight boards; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets.

Exo.36.31.bsb: He also made five crossbars of acacia wood for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,
Exo.36.31.kjv: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

Exo.36.32.bsb: five for those on the other side, and five for those on the rear side of the tabernacle, to the west.
Exo.36.32.kjv: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.

Exo.36.33.bsb: He made the central crossbar to run through the center of the frames, from one end to the other.
Exo.36.33.kjv: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.

Exo.36.34.bsb: And he overlaid the frames with gold and made gold rings to hold the crossbars. He also overlaid the crossbars with gold.
Exo.36.34.kjv: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

Exo.36.35.bsb: Next, he made the veil of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen, with cherubim skillfully worked into it.
Exo.36.35.kjv: And he made a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubims made he it of cunning work.

Exo.36.36.bsb: He also made four posts of acacia wood for it and overlaid them with gold, along with gold hooks; and he cast four silver bases for the posts.
Exo.36.36.kjv: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.

Exo.36.37.bsb: For the entrance to the tent, he made a curtain embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen,
Exo.36.37.kjv: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;

Exo.36.38.bsb: together with five posts and their hooks. He overlaid the tops of the posts and their bands with gold, and their five bases were bronze.
Exo.36.38.kjv: And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets were of brass.

Exo.26.7.bsb: You are to make curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven curtains in all.
Exo.26.7.kjv: And thou shalt make curtains of goats’ hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make.

Exo.26.8.bsb: Each of the eleven curtains is to be the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.
Exo.26.8.kjv: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure.

Exo.26.9.bsb: Join five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another. Then fold the sixth curtain over double at the front of the tent.
Exo.26.9.kjv: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.

Exo.26.10.bsb: Make fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and fifty loops along the edge of the corresponding curtain in the second set.
Exo.26.10.kjv: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.

Exo.26.11.bsb: Make fifty bronze clasps and put them through the loops to join the tent together as a unit.
Exo.26.11.kjv: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass, and put the taches into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.

Exo.26.12.bsb: As for the overlap that remains of the tent curtains, the half curtain that is left over shall hang down over the back of the tabernacle.
Exo.26.12.kjv: And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remaineth, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.

Exo.26.13.bsb: And the tent curtains will be a cubit longer on either side, and the excess will hang over the sides of the tabernacle to cover it.
Exo.26.13.kjv: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.

Exo.26.14.bsb: Also make a covering for the tent out of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of fine leather.
Exo.26.14.kjv: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering above of badgers’ skins.

Exo.36.14.bsb: He then made curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven curtains in all.
Exo.36.14.kjv: And he made curtains of goats’ hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.

Exo.36.15.bsb: Each of the eleven curtains was the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.
Exo.36.15.kjv: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains were of one size.

Exo.36.16.bsb: He joined five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another.
Exo.36.16.kjv: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

Exo.36.17.bsb: He made fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and fifty loops along the edge of the corresponding curtain in the second set.
Exo.36.17.kjv: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.

Exo.36.18.bsb: He also made fifty bronze clasps to join the tent together as a unit.
Exo.36.18.kjv: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.

Exo.36.19.bsb: Additionally, he made for the tent a covering of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of fine leather.
Exo.36.19.kjv: And he made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers’ skins above that.

Exo.39.34.bsb: the covering of ram skins dyed red, the covering of fine leather, and the veil of the covering;
Exo.39.34.kjv: And the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers’ skins, and the vail of the covering,

Exo.26.2.bsb: Each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide—all curtains the same size.
Exo.26.2.kjv: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.

Exo.26.3.bsb: Five of the curtains are to be joined together, and the other five joined as well.
Exo.26.3.kjv: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.

Exo.26.4.bsb: Make loops of blue material on the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and do the same for the end curtain in the second set.
Exo.26.4.kjv: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.

Exo.26.5.bsb: Make fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the second set, so that the loops line up opposite one another.
Exo.26.5.kjv: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.

Exo.26.6.bsb: Make fifty gold clasps as well, and join the curtains together with the clasps, so that the tabernacle will be a unit.
Exo.26.6.kjv: And thou shalt make fifty taches of gold, and couple the curtains together with the taches: and it shall be one tabernacle.

Exo.27.9.bsb: You are also to make a courtyard for the tabernacle. On the south side of the courtyard make curtains of finely spun linen, a hundred cubits long on one side,
Exo.27.9.kjv: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side:

Exo.27.10.bsb: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and silver hooks and bands on the posts.
Exo.27.10.kjv: And the twenty pillars thereof and their twenty sockets shall be of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

Exo.27.11.bsb: Likewise there are to be curtains on the north side, a hundred cubits long, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.
Exo.27.11.kjv: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings of an hundred cubits long, and his twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

Exo.27.12.bsb: The curtains on the west side of the courtyard shall be fifty cubits wide, with ten posts and ten bases.
Exo.27.12.kjv: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

Exo.27.13.bsb: The east side of the courtyard, toward the sunrise, is to be fifty cubits wide.
Exo.27.13.kjv: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

Exo.27.14.bsb: Make the curtains on one side fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases,
Exo.27.14.kjv: The hangings of one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.

Exo.27.15.bsb: and the curtains on the other side fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases.
Exo.27.15.kjv: And on the other side shall be hangings fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.

Exo.27.16.bsb: The gate of the courtyard shall be twenty cubits long, with a curtain embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen. It shall have four posts and four bases.
Exo.27.16.kjv: And for the gate of the court shall be an hanging of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework: and their pillars shall be four, and their sockets four.

Exo.36.8.bsb: All the skilled craftsmen among the workmen made the ten curtains for the tabernacle. They were made of finely spun linen, as well as blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, with cherubim skillfully worked into them.
Exo.36.8.kjv: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work made he them.

Exo.36.9.bsb: Each curtain was twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide; all the curtains were the same size.
Exo.36.9.kjv: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains were all of one size.

Exo.36.10.bsb: And he joined five of the curtains together, and the other five he joined as well.
Exo.36.10.kjv: And he coupled the five curtains one unto another: and the other five curtains he coupled one unto another.

Exo.36.11.bsb: He made loops of blue material on the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and also on the end curtain in the second set.
Exo.36.11.kjv: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.

Exo.36.12.bsb: He made fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the second set, so that the loops lined up opposite one another.
Exo.36.12.kjv: Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second: the loops held one curtain to another.

Exo.36.13.bsb: He also made fifty gold clasps to join the curtains together, so that the tabernacle was a unit.
Exo.36.13.kjv: And he made fifty taches of gold, and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches: so it became one tabernacle.

Exo.27.17.bsb: All the posts around the courtyard shall have silver bands, silver hooks, and bronze bases.
Exo.27.17.kjv: All the pillars round about the court shall be filleted with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their sockets of brass.

Exo.38.9.bsb: Then he constructed the courtyard. The south side of the courtyard was a hundred cubits long and had curtains of finely spun linen,
Exo.38.9.kjv: And he made the court: on the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, an hundred cubits:

Exo.38.10.bsb: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.
Exo.38.10.kjv: Their pillars were twenty, and their brasen sockets twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

Exo.38.11.bsb: The north side was also a hundred cubits long, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases. The hooks and bands of the posts were silver.
Exo.38.11.kjv: And for the north side the hangings were an hundred cubits, their pillars were twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

Exo.38.12.bsb: The west side was fifty cubits long and had curtains, with ten posts and ten bases. The hooks and bands of the posts were silver.
Exo.38.12.kjv: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

Exo.38.13.bsb: And the east side, toward the sunrise, was also fifty cubits long.
Exo.38.13.kjv: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.

Exo.38.14.bsb: The curtains on one side of the entrance were fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases.
Exo.38.14.kjv: The hangings of the one side of the gate were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

Exo.38.15.bsb: And the curtains on the other side were also fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases as well.
Exo.38.15.kjv: And for the other side of the court gate, on this hand and that hand, were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

Exo.38.16.bsb: All the curtains around the courtyard were made of finely spun linen.
Exo.38.16.kjv: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.

Exo.38.18.bsb: The curtain for the entrance to the courtyard was embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen. It was twenty cubits long and, like the curtains of the courtyard, five cubits high,
Exo.38.18.kjv: And the hanging for the gate of the court was needlework, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.

Exo.40.8.bsb: Set up the surrounding courtyard and hang the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard.
Exo.40.8.kjv: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.

Exo.40.33.bsb: And Moses set up the courtyard around the tabernacle and the altar, and he hung the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard. So Moses finished the work.
Exo.40.33.kjv: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.

Exo.40.22.bsb: Moses placed the table in the Tent of Meeting on the north side of the tabernacle, outside the veil.
Exo.40.22.kjv: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.

Exo.40.23.bsb: He arranged the bread on it before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded him.
Exo.40.23.kjv: And he set the bread in order upon it before the Lord; as the Lord had commanded Moses.

Exo.40.24.bsb: He also placed the lampstand in the Tent of Meeting opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle
Exo.40.24.kjv: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.

Exo.40.25.bsb: and set up the lamps before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded him.
Exo.40.25.kjv: And he lighted the lamps before the Lord; as the Lord commanded Moses.

Exo.40.26.bsb: Moses placed the gold altar in the Tent of Meeting, in front of the veil,
Exo.40.26.kjv: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail:

Exo.40.20.bsb: Moses took the Testimony and placed it in the ark, attaching the poles to the ark; and he set the mercy seat atop the ark.
Exo.40.20.kjv: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:

Exo.40.21.bsb: Then he brought the ark into the tabernacle, put up the veil for the screen, and shielded off the ark of the Testimony, just as the LORD had commanded him.
Exo.40.21.kjv: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the Lord commanded Moses.

Exo.25.10.bsb: And they are to construct an ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.
Exo.25.10.kjv: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

Exo.25.11.bsb: Overlay it with pure gold both inside and out, and make a gold molding around it.
Exo.25.11.kjv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.

Exo.25.12.bsb: Cast four gold rings for it and fasten them to its four feet, two rings on one side and two on the other.
Exo.25.12.kjv: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.

Exo.25.13.bsb: And make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
Exo.25.13.kjv: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

Exo.25.14.bsb: Insert the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, in order to carry it.
Exo.25.14.kjv: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.

Exo.25.15.bsb: The poles are to remain in the rings of the ark; they must not be removed.
Exo.25.15.kjv: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.

Exo.25.16.bsb: And place inside the ark the Testimony, which I will give you.
Exo.25.16.kjv: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.

Exo.25.18.bsb: Make two cherubim of hammered gold at the ends of the mercy seat,
Exo.25.18.kjv: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.

Exo.25.19.bsb: one cherub on one end and one on the other, all made from one piece of gold.
Exo.25.19.kjv: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.

Exo.25.20.bsb: And the cherubim are to have wings that spread upward, overshadowing the mercy seat. The cherubim are to face each other, looking toward the mercy seat.
Exo.25.20.kjv: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.

Exo.25.21.bsb: Set the mercy seat atop the ark and put the Testimony that I will give you into the ark.
Exo.25.21.kjv: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.

Exo.25.23.bsb: You are also to make a table of acacia wood two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.
Exo.25.23.kjv: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

Exo.25.24.bsb: Overlay it with pure gold and make a gold molding around it.
Exo.25.24.kjv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.

Exo.25.25.bsb: And make a rim around it a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.
Exo.25.25.kjv: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.

Exo.25.26.bsb: Make four gold rings for the table and fasten them to the four corners at its four legs.
Exo.25.26.kjv: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.

Exo.25.27.bsb: The rings are to be close to the rim, to serve as holders for the poles used to carry the table.
Exo.25.27.kjv: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.

Exo.25.28.bsb: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, so that the table may be carried with them.
Exo.25.28.kjv: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.

Exo.25.29.bsb: You are also to make the plates and dishes, as well as the pitchers and bowls for pouring drink offerings. Make them out of pure gold.
Exo.25.29.kjv: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: of pure gold shalt thou make them.

Exo.25.31.bsb: Then you are to make a lampstand of pure, hammered gold. It shall be made of one piece, including its base and shaft, its cups, and its buds and petals.
Exo.25.31.kjv: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.

Exo.25.32.bsb: Six branches are to extend from the sides of the lampstand—three on one side and three on the other.
Exo.25.32.kjv: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:

Exo.25.33.bsb: There are to be three cups shaped like almond blossoms on the first branch, each with buds and petals, three on the next branch, and the same for all six branches that extend from the lampstand.
Exo.25.33.kjv: Three bowls made like unto almonds, with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.

Exo.25.34.bsb: And on the lampstand there shall be four cups shaped like almond blossoms with buds and petals.
Exo.25.34.kjv: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds, with their knops and their flowers.

Exo.25.35.bsb: For the six branches that extend from the lampstand, a bud must be under the first pair of branches, a bud under the second pair, and a bud under the third pair.
Exo.25.35.kjv: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.

Exo.25.36.bsb: The buds and branches are to be all of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.
Exo.25.36.kjv: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold.

Exo.25.37.bsb: Make seven lamps and set them up on the lampstand so that they illuminate the area in front of it.
Exo.25.37.kjv: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.

Exo.25.38.bsb: The wick trimmers and their trays must be of pure gold.
Exo.25.38.kjv: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.

Exo.25.39.bsb: The lampstand and all these utensils shall be made from a talent of pure gold.
Exo.25.39.kjv: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.

Exo.25.40.bsb: See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.
Exo.25.40.kjv: And look that thou make them after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.

Exo.27.1.bsb: “You are to build an altar of acacia wood. The altar must be square, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high.
Exo.27.1.kjv: And thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof shall be three cubits.

Exo.27.2.bsb: Make a horn on each of its four corners, so that the horns are of one piece, and overlay it with bronze.
Exo.27.2.kjv: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.

Exo.27.3.bsb: Make all its utensils of bronze—its pots for removing ashes, its shovels, its sprinkling bowls, its meat forks, and its firepans.
Exo.27.3.kjv: And thou shalt make his pans to receive his ashes, and his shovels, and his basons, and his fleshhooks, and his firepans: all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass.

Exo.27.4.bsb: Construct for it a grate of bronze mesh, and make a bronze ring at each of the four corners of the mesh.
Exo.27.4.kjv: And thou shalt make for it a grate of network of brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brasen rings in the four corners thereof.

Exo.27.5.bsb: Set the grate beneath the ledge of the altar, so that the mesh comes halfway up the altar.
Exo.27.5.kjv: And thou shalt put it under the compass of the altar beneath, that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.

Exo.27.6.bsb: Additionally, make poles of acacia wood for the altar and overlay them with bronze.
Exo.27.6.kjv: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.

Exo.27.7.bsb: The poles are to be inserted into the rings so that the poles are on two sides of the altar when it is carried.
Exo.27.7.kjv: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear it.

Exo.27.8.bsb: Construct the altar with boards so that it is hollow. It is to be made just as you were shown on the mountain.
Exo.27.8.kjv: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shewed thee in the mount, so shall they make it.

Exo.27.19.bsb: All the utensils of the tabernacle for every use, including all its tent pegs and the tent pegs of the courtyard, shall be made of bronze.
Exo.27.19.kjv: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.

Exo.38.1.bsb: Bezalel constructed the altar of burnt offering from acacia wood. It was square, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high.
Exo.38.1.kjv: And he made the altar of burnt offering of shittim wood: five cubits was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof; it was foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.

Exo.38.2.bsb: He made a horn at each of its four corners, so that the horns and altar were of one piece, and he overlaid the altar with bronze.
Exo.38.2.kjv: And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.

Exo.38.3.bsb: He made all the altar’s utensils of bronze—its pots, shovels, sprinkling bowls, meat forks, and firepans.
Exo.38.3.kjv: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basons, and the fleshhooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he of brass.

Exo.38.4.bsb: He made a grate of bronze mesh for the altar under its ledge, halfway up from the bottom.
Exo.38.4.kjv: And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst of it.

Exo.38.5.bsb: At the four corners of the bronze grate he cast four rings as holders for the poles.
Exo.38.5.kjv: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, to be places for the staves.

Exo.38.6.bsb: And he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with bronze.
Exo.38.6.kjv: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.

Exo.38.7.bsb: Then he inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar for carrying it. He made the altar with boards so that it was hollow.
Exo.38.7.kjv: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.

Exo.29.43.bsb: I will also meet with the Israelites there, and that place will be consecrated by My glory.
Exo.29.43.kjv: And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory.

Exo.40.10.bsb: Anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils; consecrate the altar, and it shall be most holy.
Exo.40.10.kjv: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.

Exo.40.11.bsb: Anoint the basin and its stand and consecrate them.
Exo.40.11.kjv: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.

Exo.30.25.bsb: Prepare from these a sacred anointing oil, a fragrant blend, the work of a perfumer; it will be a sacred anointing oil.
Exo.30.25.kjv: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.

Exo.23.17.bsb: Three times a year all your males are to appear before the Lord GOD.
Exo.23.17.kjv: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord God.

Exo.12.14.bsb: And this day will be a memorial for you, and you are to celebrate it as a feast to the LORD, as a permanent statute for the generations to come.
Exo.12.14.kjv: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial; and ye shall keep it a feast to the Lord throughout your generations; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever.

Exo.12.42.bsb: Because the LORD kept a vigil that night to bring them out of the land of Egypt, this same night is to be a vigil to the LORD, to be observed by all the Israelites for the generations to come.
